## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, include sanitized screenshots or interaction evidence. Distinguish automated fixture tests from native browser or live-provider checks.

## Limitations and follow-up

Explain remaining risks, unsupported environments or dependency/license changes. Remove this section if it is not needed.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change within its stated scope.
- [ ] No credentials, private project data or unapproved third-party assets are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and meaningful regressions are updated, or I explained why they are unnecessary.
